defects.description: The required term for "Severity" is "Уровень серьёзности", but the translation uses "уровень серьезности" (spelling mismatch).
The heading "Escalation Reasons" is left in English; the required Russian term is "Причина эскалации" (or appropriate plural).
The heading "Escalation Resolution Paths" is left in English; the term "Resolution" should be rendered as "Резолюция".
The term "Subject" should be translated as "Объект обсуждения", but the translation uses "субъекта" / "субъектов задачи".
The term "Finding" is required to be "Вывод", but the translation uses "заключение".
